why: Shell cycle 1 (docs/v3/cycles/shell-1.md, P1 shell-1.9): an app on `BasaltProvider` and the v3 `AppShell` has no palette that lists its pages. The provider's Spotlight mounts by default (`src/provider/index.tsx:102`) and takes Mod+K; it lists `basalt-ui/commands` entries and no v3 `defineNav` item, so typing a page name finds nothing. The v3 `CommandPalette`, which lists the nav, mounted under the shell (`apps/playground/src/cycle/shell-1/FleetPalette.tsx`, rendered by each fleet page) binds Mod+B but never sees Mod+K (`.evidence/cycle-shell-1/palette.log`).
what: One palette per app, and under a v3 `AppShell` it lists every `defineNav` item.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/shell/app-shell.tsx and src/shell/commands/command-palette.tsx (who mounts the palette, who opens it from the search button)
apps/playground/src/routes/__root.tsx, apps/playground/src/demo/commands.ts and apps/playground/src/main.tsx (the playground's palette wiring)
change: Decide the owner with the architecture: either the provider does not mount Spotlight when a v3 `AppShell` is present, or `AppShell` mounts `CommandPalette` itself and wires its search button to it. Either way exactly one listener takes Mod+K, and the palette lists every `defineNav` item plus the app's commands. The playground root follows, and the PR names the cycle build's `FleetPalette.tsx` mount as removable; the cycle build is not edited (cycle 2 removes it). A test mounts `BasaltProvider` with a v3 `AppShell`, presses Mod+K and finds one dialog listing the nav items.
commits: fix: one commit in packages/basalt-ui; the playground wiring in its own commit.
acceptance: Under `BasaltProvider` and a v3 `AppShell`, Mod+K opens one palette that lists every `defineNav` item (test)
The shell's search button opens the same palette
